what: Real co-presence rig recordings (verify-copresence --plots, v0.1459.0), cut to the judged forward leg plus 1 s before it and 0.5 s after (times to the microsecond, positions to 10 micrometres), walker rows only. The first four failed steady_speed while ten builds compiled (6 to 16 fps, frames up to 488 ms; BUG-152, split out as BUG-161); the last is the rerun with every cargo, rustc and link process held at BelowNormal, which passed. Each leg is judged with judgeCopresence({ frames, walker, line, speed, onLineEpochMs: leg_start_epoch_ms, fromEpochMs: leg_start_epoch_ms, checkView: check_view }), as verify-copresence.js does.
source: .probe-rig/copresence/runs/<run>/ on the operator's machine (samples.json for the home leg, meet_samples.json for the meeting)
